_STRUMSIGHT_DIAG_TOKEN_NOTE: Intentionally empty: the diagnostics token is a SECRET and must never be committed (AGENTS.md 5). CI injects it into this file from the repository secret before the Lab APK build; locally, override it with --dart-define=STRUMSIGHT_DIAG_TOKEN=... An empty token means diagnostics are disabled (AppConfig.diagnosticsUsable) - never an empty X-Diag-Token header.
